info.name: Study Helper API
info.description:
# **Overview:

**The Study Helper API is a comprehensive platform aimed at assisting students with their study  
session schedules, learning resources, and academic statistics. The API integrates multiple  
functionalities to help students plan, track, and optimize their study activities. This solution goes  
beyond basic CRUD operations by offering complex data aggregation, real-time data  
management, personalized recommendations, and dynamic scheduling.

### Real-World Relevance:

Many students struggle to organize their study schedules and obtain study resources. This  
API addresses the need for a comprehensive study assistant that combines planning,  
resource recommendations, reminders, and progress tracking. The system is scalable, and it’s  
applicable to college students in all academic fields.

##### The Study Helper API focuses on:

● Setting exam date reminders.  
● Allowing personalized scheduling, progress tracking, and study reminders.  
● Offering external resources for subjects like online articles, researches, and  
helpful links.  
● Allowing users to share study resources (notes).

External APIs used:

- CORE API for study resources
    
- Google API
    
    - Google Calendar for marking exam datetimes
        
    - Gmail for sending notes
        
- Zen Quotes API for motivational quotes
    
- Open Trivia Database API for quiz resources

item.name: /tasks
item.description:
CRUD tasks for studying.

Request Parameters:

- Required:
    
    - `task` (string): The study task description.
        
    - `goal_date` (date, format: YYYY-MM-DD): The target completion date for the task.
        
- Optional:
    
    - `status` (boolean): Task completion status (default: false).
        

Request Body Example (POST/PUT):  
{  
"task": "Complete Python assignment",  
"goal_date": "2023-12-01",  
"status": false  
}

Response Structure (GET/POST/PUT):  
{  
"id": 1,  
"task": "Complete Python assignment",  
"status": false,  
"goal_date": "2023-12-01",  
"created_at": "2023-11-01T10:00:00Z"  
}

Error Handling:

- 400 Bad Request: Invalid request body or missing required fields.
    
- 404 Not Found: Task not found for GET/PUT/DELETE requests.

item.name: /study-schedule
item.description:
CRUD a subject they want to study with x number of hours and date to be studied.

Request Parameters:

- Required:
    
    - `study_date` (date, format: YYYY-MM-DD): The study session date.
        
    - `study_hours` (float): Total study hours planned.
        
    - `subjects` (string): Comma-separated list of subjects.
        

Request Body Example (POST/PUT):  
{  
"study_date": "2023-12-01",  
"study_hours": 5.5,  
"subjects": "Mathematics,Physics"  
}

Response Structure (GET/POST/PUT):  
{  
"id": 1,  
"study_date": "2023-12-01",  
"study_hours": 5.5,  
"subjects": "Mathematics,Physics",  
"created_at": "2023-11-01T10:00:00Z"  
}

Error Handling:

- 400 Bad Request: Missing required fields or invalid data types.
    
- 404 Not Found: Study schedule not found for GET/PUT/DELETE requests.

item.name: /send-study-notes
item.description:
Sends notes to gmail based on note id inputted.

Request Parameters:

- Required:
    
    - `to_email` (string): Recipient email address.
        
    - `note_id` (integer): ID of the study note to send.
        

Request Body Example (POST):  
{  
"to_email": "[student@example.com](https://mailto:student@example.com)",  
"note_id": 1  
}

Response Structure:  
{  
"message": "Notes sent successfully via Gmail!"  
}

Error Handling:

- 400 Bad Request: Missing required fields.
    
- 401 Unauthorized: User must authenticate with Gmail.
    
- 403 Forbidden: Missing required Gmail scope.
    
- 404 Not Found: Study note not found.

item.name: /add-exam-to-calendar
item.description:
Marks exam date on user's Google Calendar.

Request Parameters:

- Required:
    
    - `exam_date` (date, format: YYYY-MM-DD): The exam date.
        
    - `exam_time` (time, format: HH:MM): The exam time.
        
    - `subject` (string): The subject of the exam.
        

Request Body Example (POST):  
{  
"exam_date": "2023-12-15",  
"exam_time": "09:00",  
"subject": "Mathematics"  
}

Response Structure:  
{  
"message": "Exam added to Google Calendar successfully!"  
}

Error Handling:

- 400 Bad Request: Missing required fields or invalid date/time format.
    
- 401 Unauthorized: User must authenticate with Google Calendar.
    
- 403 Forbidden: Missing required Google Calendar scope.

item.name: /generate-study-statistics
/generate-study-schedule/
item.description:
Fetches /study-schedule and /study-break to generate a study schedule limited by available hours and makes intervals based on study break timer chosen. Accounts for lunch and dinner time by allotting an hour for each.

Request Parameters:

- Required:
    
    - `study_schedule_id` (integer): ID of the study schedule.
        
    - `timer_id` (integer): ID of the study break timer.
        

Response Structure:  
{  
"message": "Detailed study schedule generated successfully.",  
"schedule": \[  
{  
"subject": "Mathematics",  
"type": "study",  
"start_time": "08:00",  
"end_time": "09:00",  
"duration_minutes": 60  
},  
{  
"subject": "Mathematics",  
"type": "break",  
"start_time": "09:00",  
"end_time": "09:10",  
"duration_minutes": 10  
}  
\]  
}

Error Handling:

- 400 Bad Request: Invalid study hours or no subjects available.
    
- 404 Not Found: Study schedule or timer not found.
